def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 8]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in cells):
                for rr, cc in cells:
                    result[rr][cc] = 8
    return result
